_doc: October 2026 roster expansion, as converted. Written from the optimized files (models/files, models/legends). chains: shop lines with models/index.json keys "<lineid>:<stage>". extras: "extra:<Rip>" keys for bosses, spare forms, the Digimon World 1 set and misc Digimon Masters models; the roster maps them to line forms by adding index.json keys that point at the same file. legends: Little Legend files (models/legends/<id>.glb, clips named for js/legends.js). clips are the role names optimize.mjs kept (idle, attack, special, win for board models). textureSize is the longest side in px (shop lines 512, extras 256). Pipeline: convert-all.cjs --new, patch-textures.cjs <folders>, optimize.mjs --meshopt high [--size 256], convert-all.cjs --legends / optimize.mjs --legends.
